title: Early F-53B Exposure Induces Autism Spectrum Disorder-like Hypomyelination and Oligodendrocytes-Derived Exosomal Protein-Dependent Axonal Energy Imbalance.
authors: Li, Shen-Pan; Zhang, Jing; Zhao, Wen-Hui; Tan, Su-Qin; Chen, Hua-Lian; Chen, Xing-Yu; Zhang, Qiong; Cai, Dan; Dong, Guang-Hui; Zeng, Xiao-Wen
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨F-53B暴露致自闭症样髓鞘化异常及外泌体蛋白介导的轴突能量失衡，涉及分子对接但核心为毒理学与神经病理，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Recent epidemiological evidence links prenatal exposure to chlorinated polyfluorinated ether sulfonate (F-53B) to autism spectrum disorder (ASD)-associated neurodevelopmental deficits. However, mechanisms underlying F-53B-induced ASD-like pathology and oligodendrocyte dysfunction remain unclear. In this study, we exposed Sprague-Dawley rats to F-53B (0, 8, 80, 800 mug/kg/d from preconception through postweaning) and compared adverse outcomes to a valproic acid-induced ASD model. We found that F-53B crossed the blood-brain barrier, deposited in offspring brain, and induced ASD-like neurobehaviors, including social deficits, stereotypic behaviors, memory impairments, and reduced novelty preference. Neuropathologically, F-53B triggered hippocampal and callosal hypomyelination, delayed oligodendrocyte maturation, and disrupted neuronal mitochondrial cristae. Interestingly, plasma oligodendrocytes-derived exosomes (ODEXs) from F-53B-exposed offspring failed to restore neuronal adenosine triphosphate (ATP) levels and mitochondrial membrane potential in vitro. Proteomic profiling of ODEXs identified suppression of ATP synthesis-related proteins, notably chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 8 (an ASD-characterized biomarker) and ATP citrate lyase. Molecular docking suggested F-53B could bind to their amino acid residues. Downregulation of these proteins in the hippocampus and corpus callosum aligned with behavioral and myelination abnormalities in rat offsprings. Our study establishes ODEX-mediated ATP synthesis disruption as central to F-53B-induced ASD-like pathology, urging reevaluation of perfluorooctanesulfonate alternatives for neurotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 近期流行病学证据将产前暴露于氯化多氟醚磺酸盐（F-53B）与自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）相关的神经发育缺陷联系起来。然而，F-53B诱导的ASD样病理及少突胶质细胞功能障碍的潜在机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们将Sprague-Dawley大鼠暴露于F-53B（剂量为0、8、80、800微克/千克/天，从受孕前至断奶后），并将不良结局与丙戊酸诱导的ASD模型进行比较。我们发现F-53B穿过血脑屏障，沉积于子代大脑中，并诱导ASD样神经行为，包括社交缺陷、刻板行为、记忆损伤及新奇偏好降低。在神经病理学上，F-53B触发海马和胼胝体低髓鞘化，延迟少突胶质细胞成熟，并破坏神经元线粒体嵴结构。有趣的是，来自F-53B暴露子代血浆的少突胶质细胞来源外泌体（ODEXs）在体外未能恢复神经元三磷酸腺苷（ATP）水平和线粒体膜电位。ODEXs的蛋白质组学分析鉴定出ATP合成相关蛋白的抑制，特别是染色质域解旋酶DNA结合蛋白8（一种ASD特征性生物标志物）和ATP柠檬酸裂解酶。分子对接提示F-53B可能与其氨基酸残基结合。这些蛋白在海马和胼胝体中的下调与子代大鼠的行为和髓鞘化异常相一致。我们的研究确立了ODEX介导的ATP合成破坏是F-53B诱导ASD样病理的核心机制，敦促对全氟辛烷磺酸盐替代品进行神经毒性重新评估。
